name: 45° Back Extension
description: 45-degree hyperextension — glute, hamstring, erector strength with low spinal compression.
instructions_excerpt: Set up in a 45° hyper bench with hips on the pad. Hinge at the hips, lowering torso, then extend back to neutral by squeezing glutes. Do not hyperextend lumbar.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
description: Anti-extension core work — bridges strength and stability for climbing.
instructions_excerpt: Start on knees with hands on the ab wheel, hips over knees. Roll the wheel forward keeping spine long and pelvis posteriorly tilted. Stop before your lower back extends. Pull back by driving hips forward and engaging lats.

name: Adductor Ball Squeeze (Supine)
description: Isometric adductor squeeze — trains the inner-thigh grip used to stay on the horse.
instructions_excerpt: Lie supine with knees bent, a medicine or pilates ball between the knees. Squeeze the ball hard for 5-10 seconds, breathing throughout. Release partially, repeat.

name: Aid-Climbing Aider Step-Up Sim
description: High-step unilateral with a hanging loop — trains the deep flexed-hip step into an aider.
instructions_excerpt: Hang a single loop of webbing from a pull-up bar at waist height. Step into the loop with one foot, weight transfer, stand tall. Step down under control. 8-10 per side.

name: Alpine Crampon Box-Step
description: High step-up in stiff boots simulating a front-point kick-in — transfers to alpine and ice approach style.
instructions_excerpt: Wear stiff boots (or heavy shoes). Step onto a knee-height box by driving through the ball of the foot (as if front-pointing). Stand tall, step down slowly. Alternate feet.

name: Arch Body Hold (Reverse Hollow)
description: Posterior-chain counterpart to the hollow — trains the front-lever and back-line extension gymnasts need.
instructions_excerpt: Lie prone. Arms overhead. Lift arms, chest, and legs simultaneously into a reverse banana. Squeeze glutes. Hold 20-45 seconds.

name: Arnold Press
description: Rotational dumbbell overhead press — sweeps through full shoulder ROM.
instructions_excerpt: Sit holding dumbbells in front of shoulders, palms facing you. Press up while rotating palms to face forward at lockout. Reverse on the descent.

name: Band Pull-Apart
description: High-frequency scap/posterior-delt work — daily antagonist mini-dose.
instructions_excerpt: Stand with a light band held in both hands at shoulder height with arms extended. Pull the band apart by driving hands wide and squeezing shoulder blades together. Return under control.

name: Banded Hip Thrust (Home)
description: Band-resisted hip thrust for the home gym — same pattern as barbell hip thrust, portable setup.
instructions_excerpt: Sit with upper back against a couch or bench. Loop a heavy band over hips, anchored under both feet (or a heavy object). Drive hips up, squeezing glutes at top. Lower under control.

name: Barbell Back Squat
description: Primary bilateral lower-body compound — general athletic foundation.
instructions_excerpt: Unrack a loaded barbell onto the upper traps. Set feet ~shoulder-width, toes slightly out. Brace the core and descend by breaking at the hips and knees together, pushing the knees out over the toes. Descend to at least parallel. Drive through the feet to stand up.

name: Barbell Bench Press
description: Flat barbell bench press — primary horizontal-push strength lift.
instructions_excerpt: Lie on a flat bench with eyes under the bar. Grip slightly wider than shoulder width. Unrack, brace, lower the bar to mid-chest with control, then press to lockout. Keep feet planted and shoulder blades retracted.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
description: Heavy horizontal pull — antagonist to vertical pulling patterns common in climbing.
instructions_excerpt: Hinge at the hips to ~45° with a neutral spine and a barbell in a double overhand grip, hands just outside shoulders. Pull the bar to the lower sternum driving elbows back and squeezing shoulder blades. Lower with control to full arm extension.

name: Barbell Curl
description: Standing barbell curl — primary bilateral biceps lift.
instructions_excerpt: Stand with feet hip-width, bar at thighs in supinated grip. Curl the bar to the shoulders by flexing the elbows. Lower with control.

name: Barbell Good Morning
description: Hip hinge with bar on the back — heavy hamstring and erector emphasis.
instructions_excerpt: Bar on upper back as in a high-bar squat. Slight knee bend. Hinge at hips, lowering torso until parallel or until hamstrings limit. Stand by driving hips forward.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
description: Glute-max dominant posterior chain lift — cornerstone for cyclists, runners, and change-of-direction athletes.
instructions_excerpt: Sit with upper back against a bench, feet flat, barbell over hips. Drive hips up until shoulders, hips, and knees are in a straight line. Squeeze glutes hard at the top. Lower under control.

name: Barbell Overhead Press (Strict)
description: Standing strict barbell press — vertical-push foundation, no leg drive.
instructions_excerpt: Set bar at front rack, hip-width stance. Brace hard, press the bar straight overhead, pushing head through at lockout. Lower under control. No knee bend.

name: Barbell Shrug
description: Standing barbell shrug — upper-trap isolation.
instructions_excerpt: Hold a barbell at thigh height (or rack pin). Shrug shoulders straight up toward ears, squeeze, lower under control.

name: Bear Crawl
description: Quadrupedal locomotion — core, shoulder, and coordination for all grapplers.
instructions_excerpt: Start in a crawl position: hands under shoulders, knees under hips, knees hovering an inch off the floor. Crawl forward moving contralateral arm and leg together.

name: Belt Squat
description: Loaded squat with load hanging from hips — heavy lower-body work with zero spinal compression.
instructions_excerpt: Step onto the platform with a loaded belt clipped to hips. Squat to full depth keeping torso upright. Drive through mid-foot to stand. The load hangs below, not on the shoulders.

name: Bent-Arm Bar Hang
description: Isometric pull-up hold — pulling endurance for long paddling sessions.
instructions_excerpt: Pull up until the chin is over the bar and hold. Keep breathing. Drop when form breaks. 15-30 seconds.

name: Bent-Over Reverse Fly
description: Bent-over dumbbell reverse fly — direct posterior-delt and rhomboid load.
instructions_excerpt: Hinge forward from the hips with a flat back, dumbbells hanging below shoulders. Lift both arms out to the sides to shoulder height while squeezing the shoulder blades. Pause, then lower. 10-15 reps.

name: Bicycle Crunch
description: Alternating elbow-to-knee crunch with leg cycling — combined flexion and rotation.
instructions_excerpt: Lie on back, hands at temples. Bring one knee toward the chest while rotating the opposite elbow to meet it. Alternate sides in a smooth cycling motion.

name: Block Pull (Deadlift off Blocks)
description: Deadlift pulled from 2-4 inch blocks — reduces range of motion, allowing heavier supramaximal loading. Powerlifting staple.
instructions_excerpt: Set the barbell on blocks 2-4 inches off the floor. Set up as for a conventional deadlift from the higher start. Pull with a powerful hip drive, lock out standing tall.

name: BMX Whip Rotational Core
description: Standing cable chop simulating the whip-rotation used on BMX dirt and park.
instructions_excerpt: Cable or band anchored chest-high. Stand side-on. Drive the cable from high-side to low-opposite-knee in a whip rotation. 8-10 per side.

name: Body Row (Rings or Bar)
description: Inverted row on rings — horizontal pull strength that scales endlessly for pole and calisthenics.
instructions_excerpt: Hang under a set of rings or a bar with straight body, heels on the floor. Pull chest to the rings, retracting scaps first. Lower with control.

name: Bodybuilder Lateral Raise (Myo-Reps)
description: Dumbbell lateral raise with myo-reps — bodybuilding shoulder size-building protocol.
instructions_excerpt: Lateral raise 15-20 reps, rest 15 sec. Repeat 3-5 mini-sets of 5-8 reps with same rest. Strict form.

name: Bodybuilding Paused-Curl
description: Dumbbell curl with 2-sec pause at peak — bodybuilding-specific hypertrophy tool.
instructions_excerpt: Perform a standing dumbbell curl. At the top (bicep peak), pause 2 sec. 8-12 per side or bilaterally.

name: Bow-Draw Isometric (Banded)
description: Held band-draw isometric — archery and bow-hunting shoulder-back endurance.
instructions_excerpt: Anchor a band to a post at bow height. Take a full draw and hold for 20-30s. Release slowly. Switch sides every set.

name: Box Squat
description: Back squat to a box at parallel or below — teaches depth, breaks eccentric/concentric.
instructions_excerpt: Set a box at the desired depth behind you. Descend under control, sit fully on the box without losing tightness, then drive up.

name: Box-Step Downhill Eccentric
description: Slow eccentric step-down with a pack — the underrated prep for brutal long descents.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on a knee-height box wearing a pack. Slowly lower one foot to the floor over 3-4 seconds, barely touching before stepping back up. Keep hips level.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
description: Unilateral knee-dominant — fixes side-to-side leg imbalance.
instructions_excerpt: Stand a stride's-length in front of a bench. Place the top of the back foot on the bench. With or without dumbbells, descend by bending the front knee until the front thigh is parallel to the floor. Drive through the front foot to stand.

name: Cable Chop (Samurai Cut)
description: Cable high-to-low chop in a deep stance — diagonal-cutting power for HEMA, kendo, iaido.
instructions_excerpt: Set cable high. Stand sideways, grip handle with both hands. Rotate through a diagonal chop down and across to the far hip. Reset.

name: Cable Crossover
description: Standing cable chest fly — horizontal adduction with constant tension; bodybuilding chest isolation.
instructions_excerpt: Stand centered between two high cable pulleys. Grab a handle in each hand with a slight forward lean. Pull hands together in front of the hips in a hugging arc. Squeeze at the bottom; return slowly.

name: Cable Crunch
description: Kneeling cable crunch — heavy weighted spinal flexion for the rectus abdominis.
instructions_excerpt: Kneel facing a high cable with rope attachment, rope behind/over the shoulders. Curl the torso down toward the floor by flexing the spine. Return under control.

name: Cable Curl
description: Standing cable curl with bar or rope — constant tension biceps work.
instructions_excerpt: Face a low cable with a bar or rope attached. Curl by flexing the elbows, keeping them at your sides. Lower under tension.

name: Cable High-to-Low Chop
description: Cable chop from high to low across the body — mimics the downward-strike phase of the forehand and smash.
instructions_excerpt: Set a cable pulley high. Stand sideways, grip the handle with both hands. Chop down and across the body to the opposite hip, rotating through the torso. Return with control. 10-12 per side.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
description: Single-arm cable lateral raise — constant-tension lateral-delt work.
instructions_excerpt: Stand sideways to a low cable, handle in the outside hand. Raise arm out to the side to shoulder height, lower under tension.

name: Cable Low-to-High Lift
description: Cable lift from low to high across the body — mirrors the topspin forehand drive and open-stance strokes.
instructions_excerpt: Set a cable pulley low. Stand sideways, grip the handle with both hands. Lift up and across the body to the opposite shoulder, rotating through the torso. Return with control. 10-12 per side.

name: Cable Pull-Through
description: Hip-hinge with cable between the legs — glute and hamstring isolation with low spinal load.
instructions_excerpt: Face away from cable column with rope between legs. Hinge at the hips, hands tracking down between the knees. Stand by driving the hips forward, squeezing glutes at lockout.

name: Cable Reverse Fly
description: Standing cable reverse fly with cables crossed — rear-delt isolation with constant tension.
instructions_excerpt: Stand at a dual cable station, cables crossed (right hand grabs left cable and vice versa). Pull arms out to the sides at shoulder height, squeezing rear delts.

name: Cable Wood Chop (High-to-Low)
description: Diagonal anti-rotation and rotational-power pattern — functional carry-over to rotational sports.
instructions_excerpt: Set a cable at high position. Standing perpendicular, grip the handle with both hands at the high side. Drive the handle across and down to the opposite hip by rotating the torso — hips follow, not the other way around. Return under control.

name: Calf Drop Eccentric
description: Weighted eccentric calf drop — achilles-prevention prehab for runners.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on a step holding a dumbbell. Rise to toes on both feet, shift to one, lower slowly (3-4s) on one leg. Use both to rise back up.

name: Calisthenics Skill Flow (Crow/L-Sit/Plank)
description: Short skill-flow: plank → crow → L-sit → plank — bodyweight progression for misc rec/fitness.
instructions_excerpt: Start in plank 10s. Move to crow pose 5-10s. L-sit 5-10s. Return to plank. 3-5 rounds.

name: Canoe J-Stroke Rotational Pull
description: Seated cable pull with terminal hook — simulates canoe J-stroke finish.
instructions_excerpt: Seated on floor or low bench, cable/band at waist height. Pull to hip and finish with a small outward flick (like the J). 10-12 per side.

name: Canyoneering Stemming-Chimney Iso
description: Wall-to-wall stem position hold — bread and butter for canyon downclimbs.
instructions_excerpt: Find two walls/boxes close enough to span. Stem with feet pressing opposite walls, hips up, hold 20-45s. Repeat 3-4x.

name: Catamaran Trapeze Lean Iso
description: Harness-style backward lean isometric — simulates trapezing on a catamaran or dinghy.
instructions_excerpt: Using a harness or strap anchored low, lean backward fully straight, holding position 20-45s with feet planted.

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
description: Row performed prone on an incline bench — removes low-back involvement and isolates upper-back for pulling volume.
instructions_excerpt: Lie chest-down on a 30-45° incline bench. Let dumbbells hang at arm's length. Row both dumbbells to the ribs, squeezing the shoulder blades together. Lower under control.

name: Chin-Up
description: Bodyweight chin-up, supinated grip — biceps-biased vertical pull.
instructions_excerpt: Hang from bar with underhand (palms-facing-you) grip shoulder-width. Pull until chin clears the bar. Lower with control.

name: Clean Pull
description: Clean lift through the second pull, no catch — top-end pulling strength.
instructions_excerpt: Set up as for a clean. Pull from the floor, extend explosively at the hips and shrug hard, but do not pull under the bar. Land flat-footed with shoulders shrugged.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
description: Narrow-grip barbell bench press — triceps and lockout bias for press strength carry-over.
instructions_excerpt: Grip shoulder-width or slightly narrower. Tuck elbows close to the body, lower bar to lower chest, press to lockout. Avoid wrist-width grip — keep wrists stacked.

name: Close-Grip Push-Up
description: Triceps-dominant push — targets locked-elbow positions common in climbing.
instructions_excerpt: Assume a push-up position with hands directly under shoulders, thumbs and index fingers forming a diamond-ish shape (or simply narrow). Lower keeping elbows tracking close to the torso until chest is an inch above hands. Press back up.

name: Concentration Curl
description: Seated single-arm dumbbell curl with elbow braced on inner thigh — strict biceps isolation.
instructions_excerpt: Sit on a bench, elbow braced on inner thigh, dumbbell hanging. Curl to shoulder, squeeze hard at the top, lower fully.

name: Conventional Deadlift
description: Hip-hinge pull from the floor — ultimate full-body strength lift.
instructions_excerpt: Stand with feet hip-width, mid-foot under the bar. Hinge down and grip the bar just outside the shins. Flatten the back, brace hard, pull the slack out of the bar. Drive through the feet and stand up with the bar close to the body. Reverse by hinging at the hips first.

name: Copenhagen Adductor Lift (Dynamic)
description: Dynamic version of Copenhagen plank — adductor strength under movement, key for soccer/hockey.
instructions_excerpt: Set up as for Copenhagen plank. From lifted position, lower the bottom hip toward the floor and re-lift with control. 5-8 reps per side.

name: Cossack Squat
description: Deep lateral squat — hip mobility + unilateral strength for lateral court movement.
instructions_excerpt: Stand with wide stance. Shift weight over one leg, lowering into a deep side squat with the other leg straight. Stand up and shift to the opposite side in a flowing movement.

name: Crab-Walk with Paddle Arms
description: Reverse-facing crawl pattern — posterior shoulder, glute, and core for rafting and paddling.
instructions_excerpt: Sit with knees bent, hands behind. Lift hips. Crawl backward, driving arms and feet in a reciprocating pattern. 10-20 m.

name: Cricket Batting Stance Rotation
description: Rotational band-pull drill from cricket batting stance — trains the cover-drive pattern.
instructions_excerpt: Stand side-on in batting stance. Hold band anchored low-front. Drive hip and shoulders through band, finishing with bat-line rotation. 10-12 per side.

name: Crunch
description: Floor crunch — rectus abdominis isolation, short-range trunk flexion.
instructions_excerpt: Lie on back, knees bent, feet flat. Hands at temples (not pulling the neck). Curl the upper torso off the floor, exhale at the top. Lower with control.

name: Dance Side Plank with Leg Reach
description: Side plank with top-leg reach — core + hip combination for grand battement and turn stability.
instructions_excerpt: Side plank on forearm. Lift the top leg as high as possible (battement-style), then lower under control. 8-10 reps per side.

name: Deceleration Skater Hold
description: Landing-position isometric — trains skaters to absorb and hold a deep lateral stance.
instructions_excerpt: From standing, hop laterally onto one leg and hold the landing in a quarter-squat with the other leg trailing behind (skater pose). Hold 3-5 seconds, then reset.

name: Deficit Deadlift
description: Conventional deadlift performed from a 1-3" platform — extra range, off-the-floor strength.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on a low platform with the bar at normal height. Set up as for conventional deadlift but with knees more bent. Pull from the deeper position.

name: Depth Landing (No Rebound)
description: Drop from height and absorb silently — landing mechanics for parkour and gymnastics.
instructions_excerpt: Step off a 12-24 inch box (do not jump). Absorb the landing with quiet feet, knees tracking toes, and hips back. Stick the landing completely silently.

name: Diamond Push-Up
description: Bodyweight close-stance push-up with hands forming a diamond — triceps and inner-chest bias.
instructions_excerpt: In a push-up position place hands close so thumbs and index fingers touch, forming a diamond. Lower chest to the hands, press up.

name: Dinghy Hiking Iso Hold
description: Straight-leg hike-out isometric — sailing-specific quad and core endurance.
instructions_excerpt: Sit on a sturdy bench or edge. Anchor feet under straps or a heavy object. Lean back with straight legs, back roughly parallel to the floor. Hold 30-60s.

name: Dips (Parallel Bar)
description: Bodyweight push-pattern — shoulder-intensive, use with care.
instructions_excerpt: Support yourself on parallel bars with arms straight, shoulders depressed. Lower with control by bending elbows and leaning slightly forward until upper arms are parallel to the floor. Press back up. Avoid going below parallel unless mobility allows.

name: Downhill Step-Down (Eccentric)
description: Slow eccentric step-down — targets the quad eccentric demand of long descents.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on a 6-12" step with one leg. Slowly lower (3-5s) the other leg to tap the floor, controlling the descent entirely with the standing leg. Return to standing. Complete reps; switch sides.

name: Dragon Flag (Tuck)
description: Tucked dragon flag on a bench — advanced anti-extension core for surfers and SUP racers.
instructions_excerpt: Lie on a bench, grip behind the head. Brace the core, lift the body off the bench in a tuck position (shoulders remain planted), then lower slowly controlling the hips.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
description: Loaded horizontal push — antagonist to pulling for climbers.
instructions_excerpt: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells at chest height, elbows at ~45° from torso. Press the dumbbells up and slightly together until arms are fully extended (without locking or letting shoulders roll forward). Lower under control to chest level with dumbbells just wider than the rib cage.

name: Dumbbell Curl
description: Standing dumbbell biceps curl — alternating or simultaneous.
instructions_excerpt: Stand with dumbbells at sides, palms facing in. Curl one or both dumbbells, supinating the wrist as they pass the thigh. Lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
description: Floor press — a strength press that protects the shoulder and removes the bottom-range vulnerability (boxing, MMA shoulder health).
instructions_excerpt: Lie on the floor with knees bent. Press dumbbells from the chest to full extension. Triceps touch the floor on the eccentric — this halves the shoulder stretch range compared to a bench.
